legacy_advisor_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_next_store_no()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select nextval('public.store_no_seq')::integer;
$function$

legacy_advisor_functions.name: has_employee_permission
legacy_advisor_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_employee_permission(p_role employee_role, p_overrides jsonb, p_permission text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when jsonb_exists(coalesce(p_overrides->'denies', '[]'::jsonb), p_permission) then false
    when jsonb_exists(coalesce(p_overrides->'grants', '[]'::jsonb), p_permission) then true
    when p_role = 'admin'::public.employee_role
      then p_permission in (
        'order.create',
        'order.update',
        'order.voidOpen',
        'payment.take',
        'order.voidPaid'
      )
    when p_role = 'cashier'::public.employee_role
      then p_permission in (
        'order.create',
        'order.update',
        'order.voidOpen',
        'payment.take'
      )
    else false
  end
$function$
